method: Visual inspection of actual reimported GLB renders; independent of structural tests
notes: Six actual final-export views inspected via the hash-bound review sheet: canonical front, reverse, oblique, contact detail, neutral material close-up and side oblique.

Cavities, board-only reverse surfaces and continuous body/contact material are visible. Some decimation shading lines and angular authored profile sections remain visible; this is not a photorealistic or dimensional-fidelity certification.
No ropes, mounting hardware, logo, texture image, reference plane or environmental object appears in the production asset.

Four/seven/eight front recesses and four top contacts reviewed. Nineteen recesses plus four top contacts give 23 physical IDs. Upper angle handedness and per-position depth assignment remain unverified.
Fresh six-view render set reviewed during revision 2. The GLB is byte-identical to the preceding delivery; this review is not an assertion of newly resolved physical dimensions.
unresolved: The physical inventory is 19 front recesses plus four upper contacts: 23, not the unsupported earlier 24-contact count.

The manufacturer publishes depth families but no inspected source binds every family member to a numbered pocket. Positions are photo-supported; per-position depth assignments are explicitly authored estimates.

The two upper sloper angles are published as 32.5 and 22.5 degrees, but their handed assignment is not independently established. Left/right assignments here are display choices, not manufacturer claims.
The central 35-degree bar has an authored sloping cavity floor; its nominal 35 mm grip length is not certified as a 35 mm curved contact arc.
Tier relief, rear plane, local radii and hole centres are estimates. The 55 cm depth in a retailer listing is rejected as inconsistent with the manufacturer 55 mm value.
